# StatsLab EdTech R&D Ecosystem (Web App LLM Directive)

> **StatsLab DSI** is an Islamic-based Open Source EdTech R&D ecosystem in Indonesia, developed by **Muhammad Khoiruzzadittaqwa (muhzadit)** from **Tadris Matematika, Institut Al-Bahjah Cirebon**.
> **Production Web Application:** https://dstatistika.pages.dev/  
> **Repository:** https://github.com/zaditprodakwah/statslab  
> **Open Science Empirical Dataset (Kaggle):** https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/muhzadit/statslab-dsi-empirical-data
